latency.desc: Time to first byte = connect (DNS/TCP/TLS) + upstream wait. High upstream wait means the channel itself is slow; high connect or TLS means your own egress or the edge hop is the problem. A zero under connect has three causes: the connection was reused, the upstream is plain http, or the upstream address is a bare IP; check the reused rate and the channel URL instead of reading it as fast. Only requests that produced a first byte are counted.

reconcile.desc: Daily reconciliation of billing and settlements; mismatches plus backup/archive failures raise alerts and push to the webhook.
reconcile.noteDesc: Writes only the note and status; not a single figure changes. Use it for days whose difference is understood but genuinely uncorrectable — the evidence aged out of the request-log window, or the difference came from the product policy in force at the time. Recomputing never overwrites a recorded note.

metrics.desc: Read-only snapshot of the same totals Prometheus scrapes, refreshed every 30 seconds. Counts are cumulative, not windowed: a zero means nothing has ever been recorded, not that traffic stopped.
metrics.statusEmpty: No request has reached a terminal status yet.

silence.title: Silence windows
silence.desc: During maintenance, alerts are still recorded but not delivered. Windows expire automatically.
silence.timeRequired: Start and end time are required

budgets.desc: Periodic per-user or per-key spend caps. 'warn' notifies near the limit; 'block' rejects new requests.
budgets.inputInvalid: Scope ID and a positive limit are required

hero.title: Marshall many upstreams into one dependable set of models
hero.subtitle: Switchyard sits between providers and your clients: aggregate channels, marshal and route them by price, latency, and success rate, serve one protocol, and meter every call — all in a single self-hosted binary.

flow.title: Four steps, from track to invoice
flow.subtitle: Every call takes the same path: arrive, marshal, dispatch, meter.
flow.step1Desc: OpenAI, Anthropic, image, and video upstreams each keep their own keys and limits.
flow.step2Desc: One model name is one group; several channels can back it, ordered by sequence, price, latency, or composite score.
flow.step3Desc: Requests leave along the best-scoring route; failures, timeouts, and rate limits switch tracks automatically, and egress can be pooled.
flow.step4Desc: Reserve before, settle after; text by token, images by count, video by clip. Ledger and reconciliation stay auditable.

features.title: Everything in one console
features.subtitle: From onboarding to operations, managed in a single dashboard.
features.gatewayDesc: OpenAI Chat / Responses and Anthropic Messages translate between protocols; one key calls every model.
features.channelsDesc: A model name can back onto many channels, each with its own keys, protocol bits, and limits.
features.groupsDesc: A group is the model name clients see; 7 routing modes (priority, price, latency, success rate, composite score...) with automatic failover.
features.billingDesc: Pre-deduct before calls, settle after, daily reconciliation; text by token, image per piece, video per clip; multi-currency pricing with channel-level markup and upstream bill import for reconciliation.
features.opsDesc: Real-time stats, hourly usage trends, log search, audit and rate limiting, health probes and alerts, encrypted backup and off-site push.
features.accessDesc: Three roles — admin, reseller, user — with separate API keys and balances; registration with optional approval.
features.whiteLabelDesc: Configurable site name, description, and contact; Simplified / Traditional Chinese and English, light and dark themes.
features.marketDesc: Publish channels with one click; 4-digit share codes are locked for lifetime. Users browse models and pricing by code, with channel-level markup.

media.title: Protocols & billing
media.subtitle: The inbound API always keeps the OpenAI shape; billing is per modality.
media.protocolsDesc: OpenAI Chat Completions · OpenAI Responses · Anthropic Messages · Image generation & edits · Video generation · Multi-currency settlement (USD baseline)
media.textDesc: Chat and reasoning models billed by token.
media.imageDesc: Full forwarding for generations and edits (multi-image).
media.videoDesc: Create a task and poll for the result; job ownership is persisted and traceable.
media.videoPrice: Per-video base + per-second rate; resolution tiers optional

roles.title: Three roles, each scoped
roles.subtitle: Navigation is trimmed by role; you only see what you can use.
roles.adminDesc: Platform-wide: channels & grants, users, audit, rate limits, ops center, and settings
roles.resellerDesc: Own channels: connect upstreams, publish to the market, set pricing and markup, API keys and billing
roles.userDesc: Model market, API keys, balance and usage analytics (hourly/daily, ranked by cost, count or tokens)

cta.title: Ready to get started?
